scope: Supplemental accepted-name, synonym and rank resolution for existing Poaceae Aristida purpurea learner; no specimen/photo certification

prior_uncertainties_addressed: ARIS-11 direct POWO mapping of var. wrightii
ARIS-12 direct POWO mapping of var. parishii

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts this as a separate species, published 1903, not a variety of modern narrow Aristida purpurea.

Direct POWO synonym page and accepted species page independently confirm the 1984 combination is a homotypic synonym of accepted A. wrightii. Resolves prior ARIS-11 accepted-target uncertainty under POWO, without changing older ITIS authority-specific acceptance.
Direct POWO accepted-species page places the 1912 A. parishii name as a heterotypic synonym of accepted A. wrightii.

Direct POWO accepted-species page explicitly lists the 1984 variety as heterotypic synonym of A. wrightii. Resolves prior ARIS-12 missing-direct-POWO-mapping question; ITIS still accepts the variety under its alternative broad treatment.
Direct POWO accepted-species page explicitly lists the 1979 variety as a heterotypic synonym of A. wrightii, not a separate accepted variety under POWO.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposed automatic mapping of all historical Aristida purpurea var. wrightii/parishii labels into modern narrow Aristida purpurea
scientific_decisions.reason: Current POWO/WCVP places both historical varieties under separately accepted A. wrightii. This FAIL rejects a blanket accepted-name mapping, not the validity of the historical labels.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual learner photos, specimens, or field records identified under broad Aristida purpurea varieties
scientific_decisions.reason: Nomenclatural crosswalk cannot independently reidentify a photographed or vouchered individual; preserve existing photo and diagnostic concept holds.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Hybrid or introgression parentage of any Aristida purpurea/Aristida wrightii individual
scientific_decisions.reason: No individual genetic or parentage evidence evaluated. No hybrid formula inferred.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Broad Allred 1984 and ITIS variety-level treatment versus narrower POWO/WCVP accepted species
scientific_decisions.reason: The direct POWO name mappings are now resolved, but the taxonomic circumscription disagreement remains; historical field records cannot be bulk reallocated across concepts.

authority: POWO/WCVP 2026 with original Allred 1984 treatment and ITIS alternative rank
limitations: No claim that historical voucher specimens or learner photographs have been independently reidentified.
Older authority-specific broad variety treatments remain scientifically documented, not deleted.
No new learner species installed; any future separate Aristida wrightii installation is outside this taxonomy-only scope.
Existing scientific HOLD and UNRESOLVED conditions remain; only the precise direct-POWO-name-mapping uncertainty has new evidence.
